name: Xciel XCiPhone 17
summary: The Xciel XCiPhone 17 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) case for the Apple iPhone 17, certified for Zone 2 under ATEX, and for Class I Division 2 in North America. The phone inside is a standard Apple iPhone 17 running iOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management as other iPhones.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc

certification.northAmerica: LabTest LC25-5610-1 (2026-03-06): Class I Division 2 Groups A-D T6; IP54; Ta −20 to +50 °C (CSA C22.2 No. 213-17, UL 121201). XCiPhone17 version only

safety.conditions: Charging and wired accessories only outside hazardous areas. Not for C1D1, Zone 0, 1, 20, 21 or 22. The XCiPhone17 (Class I Division 2 and ATEX Zone 2) is installed by Xciel; the XCiPhone17-A (ATEX Zone 2 only) can be installed by the customer following Xciel's procedure.
